template.title: The Marble and the Moonlit Snail
template.summary: A kind child helps a snail and finds a glowing pebble.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_name]] loved to play with [[slot_pet]] and [[slot_toy]] on sunny days.
One morning, they went to the park and saw a big sandbox called [[slot_sandbox]].
When [[slot_name]] rolled [[slot_toy]] into the sandbox, it disappeared under the sand.
[[slot_name]] felt sad and searched for the marble.
Suddenly, a tiny snail with a shell that looked like a [[slot_pebble]] slid by.
The snail was slow, and [[slot_name]] thought about pushing it away.
But [[slot_name]] remembered how [[slot_pet]] liked to help others, so they gently lifted the snail.
They followed the snail to a bright flower pot where the snail's home was.
The snail thanked [[slot_name]] by giving a glowing [[slot_pebble]] that sparkled like a tiny star.
[[slot_name]] shared the glowing pebble with [[slot_friend]] and they both giggled.
Later, [[slot_name]] and [[slot_pet]] played with the marble again, and the pebble shone beside them.
They learned that caring for a small friend can bring bright surprises.
